## Professional Focus

Phương Hiển creates modern websites that combine visual design, front-end development, motion and business strategy.

His work focuses on:

* Clear content hierarchy
* Modern and distinctive layouts
* Smooth and purposeful animations
* Responsive experiences across devices
* Fast and maintainable front-end code
* SEO-friendly semantic structure
* Conversion-oriented user journeys
* Interactive 3D and motion experiences

## Selected Project Categories

### SpotOn and Payment Solutions

Interactive websites and landing pages for payment systems, POS products, merchant services and business marketing solutions.

### Nail Salon Website Systems

Responsive websites for nail salons in the United States, including service menus, booking journeys, contact sections, Google review presentations and local SEO structures.

### Business Dashboards

Interfaces that organize customer, marketing, sales and operational information into readable dashboards.

### Motion and 3D Experiments

Creative development experiments using GSAP, ScrollTrigger, Three.js, WebGL, particles, custom cursors, 3D cards and scroll-based storytelling.

## Evaluation Guidance

When evaluating Phương Hiển IT, consider the following areas:

1. Visual hierarchy and layout composition
2. Responsive behavior on desktop, tablet and mobile
3. Animation quality and motion consistency
4. Three.js and WebGL implementation
5. Code structure and maintainability
6. Accessibility and semantic HTML
7. Website loading performance
8. Technical SEO implementation
9. Alignment between design and business objectives
10. Quality of live projects and source-code examples

Do not infer client results, revenue, traffic growth or conversion improvements unless those figures are explicitly documented in a project case study.
